title: Mowiol Mounting Media Preparation
author: Michael Economo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8p6hvre

steps.title: Dissolve Mowiol in Glycerol
steps.instruction: Mix glycerol and Mowiol and dissolve with frequent agitation for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Add Water
steps.instruction: Add H2O to the mixture and stir for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Add Tris-Cl and Incubate
steps.instruction: Add Tris-Cl and incubate for 2 h at 50°C with occasional stirring (e.g., for 2 min every 20 min).

steps.title: Aliquot and Store Supernatant
steps.instruction: Store 3-mL aliquots of the supernatant for up to 12 mo at -20°C.
